items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: You got the wrecks that beat most around Malcolm E. Coming up, we better be going nothing.

ctx.x: You got to give them. They don't have no traffic. Their parade goes on. It's smooth as anything. And they come down to no business street. On the street, be tied to be St. Charles. Well, they got it tied up on the counter for the wrecks. Yeah, yeah. Well, that's special. They got it special for that. Another thing. You see, we don't beat the wrecks at St. Charles and Louisiana Avenue. Yeah. You can't come down to St. Charles. No, that's right. You got the wrecks that beat most around Malcolm E. Coming up, we…
Yeah, you see a lot of fellas.
